title: What is a workflow? With a worked example | 50agents
description: A workflow is the order of steps a piece of work goes through, start to finish. It exists by hand or in software; automating it hands the steps to software.
definition: A workflow is the order of steps a piece of work goes through from start to finish, such as: a contact signs up, they are added to a list, the team is told.
It exists whether people do it by hand or software runs it; automating a workflow means software does some or all of the steps.

example.ask: Set up an automation: every new Shopify order is added as a row to my Google Sheet with its items and total
example.why: By hand, this workflow is: see the order in Shopify, copy the items and total into the sheet, check nothing was missed. Automated, the order of steps stays; only who walks it changes.
